Construct each diagnostic example by interaction index: target=h[t], prefix=h[:t]; retain prefix[-L:] and left-pad with zero to length L. Skip empty prefixes. Preserve repeated items: an earlier occurrence of the target is legitimate history, while the target event itself must be excluded. For loader tensors, positive[b,j] pairs with sequence[b,:j+1], excluding padding; never use the complete sequence to predict an earlier target. This follows [SASRec’s shifted sampler](https://github.com/kang205/SASRec/blob/master/sampler.py).

For independently constructed, right-aligned prefixes, extract log2feats(sequence)[:, -1, :], not nonzero_count−1, which indexes incorrectly under left padding. For positionwise training diagnostics, use features[:,j,:] with positive[:,j]. Repacking a prefix can shift absolute positions, so distinguish these measurements. With features [B,D], shared candidates [C] require features @ embeddings.T; per-example candidates [B,C] require (embeddings * features[:,None,:]).sum(-1). Both return [B,C]; assert dimensions, including B=1/C=1, and verify against scalar dot products. The [PyTorch implementation](https://github.com/pmixer/SASRec.pytorch/blob/main/python/model.py) confirms final-position extraction and embedding scoring.

Recommended adapter checks: inspect indexed toy histories; assert exact prefix/target construction, valid IDs, padding, finite scores, unique negatives excluding the target, and exactly one positive candidate. In eval/no_grad mode, altering future tokens must leave earlier features unchanged; candidate permutation must only permute scores. Earlier target membership alone is not leakage. Label training-derived ranks as training fit, even when sampled freshly after training. Compare against popularity, shuffled-prefix, and target-permutation controls; stratify repeated versus novel targets. Generalization evidence remains the unchanged pinned validation HR@10, macro-averaged across four categories. High training ranks with weak validation indicate a fit/generalization gap, not demonstrated improvement.
